item.title: Nida Connect 1.3.0
item.description:
### New
- **Setup that asks questions.** Each step asks one thing and picks the settings for you: how you want to see the time, how you want to be alerted, and whether this Mac plays the adhan. A Change button in the settings opens the setup at the right step. - **Five menu bar styles.** Icon only (Nida's mosque, nothing else), Prayer time (the time of the next prayer, such as `15:42`), Compact (the countdown), With name and Precise (with seconds). Pick one in the setup or from the Style menu in the settings. - **Nida's voice in your language.** Standalone, the pre-adhan jingle is now the voiced Nida jingle in the app's language (English when there is none). Any other jingle from the library can still be chosen.
### Changed
- **Shorter settings.** About ten rows: source, menu bar style, alerts, notifications, sound and general. Everything else (calculation method, pre-adhan per prayer, each sound and volume, seconds, blinking colon, separate notifications) is under Advanced, folded away. - **One voice for the adhan.** Standalone, choosing the adhan voice also picks the Fajr adhan by the same reciter when the library has one.
